text:
Emilia (Design): Quick UX check on a compact 'Suppression Preview' we sketched for SLO thresholds. Idea: tiny timeline + popover detail so users can glance when alerts will be silenced. Figma: https://figma.redwood/suppression-compact (WIP)
Raj - Eng: Nice. How does conflict resolution show when multiple suppression rules overlap?
Emilia (Design): We show stacked color bars; on hover/popover we list active rules and highlight the one that will apply. For keyboard/VO we present a list order matching visual stack.
Lina - PM: Copy ask: popover title should read 'Suppression details' not 'Suppression info' — more action oriented.
Theo A11y: Keyboard notes: popover must be focus-trapped while open, Esc returns focus to the timeline cell. Add an aria-live message like 'Suppression details opened'.
Raj - Eng: Implementation: we'll return up to 5 upcoming suppression windows from the API and render the rest as "+N more" with a link to expand. Avoid expanding >30 days by default.
Emilia (Design): Visual nit: small pill text currently fails contrast at smaller sizes. I'll bump contrast and add a dot-pattern option for colorblindness.
Lina - PM: Mobile behavior? Timeline compresses to a single row with chevrons to show each day. Popover becomes full-screen sheet.
Raj - Eng: Performance: lazy-load popover contents; don't fetch channel-specific previews until user opens detail.
Theo A11y: Screen reader copy: provide a concise SR-only summary: 'Next suppressions: Oct 21 22:00 for 6h (Night maintenance), Oct 24 00:00 for 24h (Holiday)'. Keep it to 2-3 entries.
Emilia (Design): I'll update mocks with new copy, contrast, and include SR summary example. Adding checklist: [ ] change title, [ ] add aria-live, [ ] limit preview to 30d, [ ] contrast + pattern, [ ] lazy-load details.
PreviewBot: Reminder: run integration test after design changes to ensure focus management passes.
Emilia (Design): Thanks — dropping a follow-up with updated Figma later today. If anyone thinks of shorter pill labels for mobile (2-3 chars), post suggestions here.
